stable_facts.face_structure: Chinese male, late 20s to early 30s; long oval-rectangular face, defined cheekbones, straight severe jawline, squared but not bulky chin, balanced mature proportions.
stable_facts.eyes: Medium narrow almond eyes, slightly hooded upper lids, direct restrained gaze, no smile, no idol softness.
stable_facts.brows: Thick dark straight brows with mild inward tension; brows sit relatively low and create a controlled CEO severity.
stable_facts.nose: Straight medium-high bridge, narrow clean nose line, realistic nostril shape, no exaggerated sculpting.
stable_facts.mouth: Medium lips held in a flat restrained line; corners neutral or slightly downturned.
stable_facts.hair: Dense black short hair, swept back and slightly to one side, controlled volume on top, neat sides and temples, no long fringe.
stable_facts.body_type: Tall lean athletic body, broad but not oversized shoulders, slim tailored waist, upright posture.
stable_facts.costume_silhouette: Black tailored suit, crisp white shirt, slim black tie, minimal silver watch detail, polished black leather shoes.
stable_facts.skin_texture: Natural light skin tone with subtle real skin texture and pores; polished Korean-drama grooming without plastic skin.
stable_facts.lighting_direction: Cool daylight from upper front-left with soft fill; visible detail in shadow areas; avoid high-contrast noir lighting.
stable_facts.scene_anchor: Luxury wedding/red-carpet entrance with bodyguards in black suits behind him.

allowed_variation.expression: Neutral, cold, mildly suspicious, injured restraint; no broad smile.
allowed_variation.costume: Black suit, charcoal suit, black overcoat only for later public/business states; white shirt may become open-collar only after plot allows emotional or injury shift.
allowed_variation.pose: Standing still, walking forward, adjusting cuff/watch, one hand in pocket, guarded injury posture.

known_drift_risks: Generating four states in one image changes his face between panels.
Text-only Liu Xiaoxu direction can drift into a different actor; use temperament only, never exact likeness.
Face can become too young, idol-like, smiling, rounder, or greasy霸总.
Hair can become messy idol fringe instead of controlled short CEO styling.
Lighting can become too contrasty; keep Korean premium daylight with transparent shadows.
generation_rule: Use the source image as the identity reference before every new Lu Zhichen character image. Generate one state per image, then assemble boards locally only after visual review passes.
